    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.isPresilting_of_torsion_pair_tests (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (B M : FGModuleCat R) (pair : ∀ (X : FGModuleCat R), generatedTorsionClass B X ↔ Subsingleton (X ⟶ M)) (surj : Function.Surjective ⇑(P.precompose B)) (inj : Function.Injective ⇑(P.precompose M)) :
    P.IsPresilting

    A differential is presilting if precomposition is surjective on a generator of a torsion class and injective on a module cutting out that class.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_generic_grain_kernel_of_fixedWeightTorsionCriteria (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] (γ : ProjectiveClass R) (hγ : ¬∃ (P : TwoTerm R), P.IsPresilting ∧ P.projectiveClass = γ) (criterion : FixedWeightTorsionCriteria k ((realProjectiveClass R) γ)) :
    ∃ (N : ModuleCat R), IsEndofinite N ∧ SplitsOnCogeneratedModules k N ∧ perpendicularToModule N = ((projectiveClassWeight k) γ).weakTorsionClass ∧ (cogeneratedByModule N = fun (X : FGModuleCat R) => ∀ {U : FGModuleCat R} (i : U ⟶ X) [CategoryTheory.Mono i], ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero U → ((projectiveClassWeight k) γ).eval U < 0) ∧ ∃ (G : ModuleCat R), Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Retract G N) ∧ IsGenericGrain k G

    At every prescribed weight outside the fan, the fixed-weight torsion criterion implies the grain proposition with its two numerical classes and direct summand.
